community-ss-uiuc-mscs.summary: The Urbana-Champaign MS in Computer Science requires thesis research. Students must secure a thesis advisor.
community-ss-uiuc-mscs.research_areas: Systems and networking faculty and groups include distributed systems, cloud computing, and systems for machine learning.

ucsd-ms-cs-la-jolla.summary: The Computer Science MS offers a Plan I thesis with independent research and a thesis chair.
ucsd-ms-cs-la-jolla.research_areas: CSE research areas include systems and networking, natural language processing, security and cryptography, and human-computer interaction through The Design Lab.

gatech-mscs-atlanta.summary: The on-campus MSCS offers a thesis option requiring advance approval from a College of Computing faculty advisor and the MSCS coordinator.
gatech-mscs-atlanta.research_areas: The Compiler Lab describes an MSCS student pursuing thesis research in the lab, one example of faculty-supervised research.

uw-mscss-tacoma.summary: The Tacoma MS in Computer Science and Systems offers a thesis pathway. Students develop the proposal with a faculty advisor.
uw-mscss-tacoma.research_areas: The faculty directory lists Computer Science and Systems interests including cryptography, software engineering, and data science.

community-a-minus-brown-scmcs.summary: The Computer Science ScM has a research option built around a project with a faculty member.
community-a-minus-brown-scmcs.research_areas: Brown CS publishes research opportunities for master's students and links to prior master's project reports.

nyu-mscs-tandon-brooklyn.summary: The Tandon MS in Computer Science lists research areas such as AI and machine learning, algorithms, cybersecurity, and computer systems.
nyu-mscs-tandon-brooklyn.research_areas: Tandon's computer science department lists the Algorithms and Foundations Group and the Game Innovation Lab among its labs and centers.

duke-ms-ece-durham.summary: The Duke MS in Electrical and Computer Engineering offers a thesis option based on faculty-led research.
duke-ms-ece-durham.research_areas: The program describes research clusters and study areas including systems for AI, quantum computing systems, and semiconductors.
